title: Launch alignment retreat and rolling schedule automation
creator: Priya Desai
description: Run a two-day cross-functional alignment retreat followed by building a small 'calendar-as-code' automation to reduce manual coordination for release train slot reservation. Outcome: a deployable prototype that maps initiatives/OKRs to prioritized launch windows, enforces blackout rules, and emits notifications to owners and SRE. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, and SRE work to pilot the flow across runtime, console, and API teams.
acceptance_criteria: Retreat artifacts: decision log and prioritized slot matrix checked into Drive
Prototype service that creates/updates launch windows via API and writes schedule to Shared Calendar (read-only)
Automated gating rules implemented for regional blackout windows and capacity hedges
Pilot completed with 2 release trains (runtime + console) and feedback captured in retro
Runbook for manual override and rollback documented and linked

risks_and_tradeoffs: Automating slot assignment reduces manual friction but may increase coordination complexity if teams rely on ad-hoc overrides; mitigation: require owner-level approval workflow for overrides

Tight coupling with Dedicated autoscaling signals could cause false rejections of launch slots during transient capacity events; mitigation: use capacity hedging window and a suppression threshold for transient signals
Full calendar-as-code rollout requires org adoption — plan phased pilot and provide a simple UI for non-technical owners

Prepare retro template and success metrics (on-time launches, number of manual overrides, notification latency)
